greetSimpler.en: Today we learn times tables and quick ways to multiply.

asidePark.hi: {aside} ki baat bhi hogi, bas yeh guna khatam ho jaaye.

asidePark.hi: Haan, {aside} wali baat pakki, thodi der mein usi par lautenge.
asidePark.en: Yes, the {aside} bit is a promise, and we'll come back to it soon.

askAgain.en: Say it once more, I'm listening.

hook.convey: equal groups everywhere (egg trays of 6, overs of 6 balls) → multiplication counts equal groups in one go; facts up to 10 × 10 come from equal groups, equal jumps and a nearby easy fact

use.hi: Kitchen mein ande tray mein aate hain, har tray mein 6, aur Maa ne 3 tray rakhi hain. Aaj dekhenge ki bina ek-ek gine kul ande kaise nikalte hain.
use.en: In the kitchen eggs come in trays of 6, and Mum has kept 3 trays. Today we see how to find all the eggs without counting them one by one.

use.hi: Cricket mein ek over mein 6 ball hoti hain. Bowler jitne bhi over daale, kul ball guna se turant pata chal jaati hain.
use.en: In cricket an over has 6 balls. However many overs a bowler bowls, multiplying tells the total balls at once.

explain.convey: 3 egg trays, 6 in each → 3 equal groups of 6 → 3 × 6 = 6 + 6 + 6 = 18; first number = how many groups, second = how many in each

point.hi: Pehle 3 tray aayin, aur har tray mein 6 ande. Yeh 3 barabar group hain, har group mein 6. 3 × 6 ka matlab hai 6 + 6 + 6, yaani 18 ande.
point.en: First 3 trays came, with 6 eggs in each tray. These are 3 equal groups of 6. 3 × 6 means 6 + 6 + 6, that is 18 eggs.

prompt.hi: Ab 2 tray aur aa gayin, aur har tray mein 6 ande hain. 5 tray mein kul kitne ande hain?
prompt.en: Now 2 more trays come, with 6 eggs in each tray. How many eggs are there in 5 trays?

why.hi: 3 tray mein 18 the; 5 tray hain, har tray mein 6 ande, toh 5 × 6 = 30
why.en: 3 trays held 18; 5 trays of 6 eggs each make 5 × 6 = 30

simpler.hi: Har tray mein 6 ande hain, toh 5 tray matlab 5 baar 6. 3 tray mein 18 the, ab 2 tray aur jodo, har ek mein 6.
simpler.en: Each tray has 6 eggs, so 5 trays means 5 times 6. 3 trays held 18, so now add 6 for each of 2 more trays.

explain.convey: multiplying as equal jumps from 0: the same jump made again and again, as many times as the first number says; adding is one join only. Told as the method over the ask's board, with no other example numbers

point.hi: Guna ko chhalaang se socho. 0 se shuru karo, aur ek hi naap ki chhalaang baar-baar lagao, jitni baar guna kehta hai. Jahan ruko, wahi jawab hai. Jod mein aisa nahi hota: wahan sirf ek baar jodte hain.
point.en: Think of multiplying as jumps. Start at 0 and make jumps of the same size again and again, as many times as the multiplication says. Where you stop is the answer. Adding is not like that: there you join just once.

prompt.hi: Isi tarah 0 se 7 chhalaang lagao, har chhalaang 3 ki. Kahan pahunchoge, yaani 7 × 3 kitna hai?
prompt.en: In the same way make 7 jumps of 3 from 0. Where do you land, that is, what is 7 × 3?

why.hi: 0 se shuru karke 3 ki 7 chhalaang 3, 6, 9, 12, 15, 18, 21 par pahunchti hain
why.en: starting at 0, 7 jumps of 3 land on 3, 6, 9, 12, 15, 18, 21

simpler.hi: 0 se shuru karke har chhalaang mein 3 aage jao. Aisi 7 chhalaang poori karo; jahan ruko, wahi jawab hai.
simpler.en: Start at 0 and go 3 forward with each jump. Make 7 such jumps; where you stop is the answer.

explain.convey: a fact next to 10: 10 times a number is easy; 9 groups are one group fewer than 10 groups → take one group away from the 10 fact. Told as the method over the ask's board, with no other example numbers

point.hi: Koi fact mushkil lage, toh paas wala aasaan fact lo. 10 se guna sabse aasaan hai. 9 group, 10 group se 1 group kam hain, toh 10 wale jawab mein se bas ek group ghatao.
point.en: If a fact feels hard, take the easy fact next to it. Multiplying by 10 is the easiest. 9 groups are one group fewer than 10 groups, so just take one group away from the 10 answer.

prompt.hi: Isi tarike se 9 × 4 nikalo. 10 × 4 = 40 se shuru karo. 9 × 4 kitna hai?
prompt.en: Find 9 × 4 the same way. Start from 10 × 4 = 40. What is 9 × 4?

why.hi: 9 × 4 mein 10 × 4 = 40 se 1 group kam hai: 40 − 4 = 36
why.en: 9 × 4 is 1 group fewer than 10 × 4 = 40: 40 − 4 = 36

simpler.hi: 10 × 4 = 40 mein 4 ke 10 group hain. 9 × 4 mein ek group kam hai, toh 40 mein se ek 4 hatao.
simpler.en: 10 × 4 = 40 is 10 groups of 4. 9 × 4 has one group fewer, so take one 4 away from 40.

problem.hi: Ek packet mein 9 biscuit hain. Rahul class party ke liye 7 packet khareedta hai. Rahul ke paas kul kitne biscuit hain?
problem.en: A packet has 9 biscuits. Rahul buys 7 packets for a class party. How many biscuits does Rahul have?

simpler.hi: Har packet mein 9 biscuit hain, aur 7 packet hain. Toh 9 ko 7 baar jodna hai, yaani 7 × 9.
simpler.en: Each packet has 9 biscuits, and there are 7 packets. So we add 9 seven times, that is 7 × 9.

find.hi: Rahul ke paas kul kitne biscuit hain

do.hi: Pehle dekho ki yeh barabar group hain
do.en: First see that these are equal groups

why.hi: 7 packet barabar hain aur har packet mein 9 biscuit hain
why.en: the 7 packets are equal, with 9 biscuits in each packet

simpler.hi: 7 packet hain, har ek mein 9 biscuit. Sab packet barabar hain, toh yeh 7 × 9 hai.
simpler.en: There are 7 packets with 9 biscuits in each. All the packets are equal, so this is 7 × 9.

do.hi: Ab paas wala aasaan fact lo
do.en: Now take the easy fact next to it

why.hi: 10 se guna aasaan hai, jaise har packet mein 10 hon
why.en: multiplying by 10 is easy, as if each packet had 10

simpler.hi: Socho har packet mein 10 hote, toh 7 × 10 = 70. 10 se guna karna aasaan hai.
simpler.en: Imagine each packet had 10; then 7 × 10 = 70. Multiplying by 10 is easy.

prompt.hi: Par har packet mein 10 nahi, 9 hain, yaani har packet mein 1 kam. Toh 70 mein se 7 ghatao. Kul kitne biscuit hain?
prompt.en: But each packet has 9, not 10, so each packet has 1 fewer. So take 7 away from 70. How many biscuits in all?

simpler.hi: Har packet mein 1 biscuit kam hai, aur packet 7 hain. Woh 7 biscuit 70 mein se nikaal do.
simpler.en: Each packet has 1 biscuit fewer, and there are 7 packets. Take those 7 biscuits out of 70.

why.hi: har packet mein 1 kam hai, toh 7 × 10 = 70 mein se 7 ghatao: 70 − 7 = 63
why.en: each packet has 1 fewer, so take 7 from 7 × 10 = 70: 70 − 7 = 63

answer.hi: Rahul ke paas kul 63 biscuit hain: 7 × 9 = 63

why.hi: har packet mein 1 kam hai, toh 7 × 10 = 70 mein se 7 ghatao: 70 − 7 = 63
why.en: each packet has 1 fewer, so take 7 from 7 × 10 = 70: 70 − 7 = 63

prompt.hi: School trip mein 6 auto hain, aur har auto mein 4 bachche baithe hain. Kul kitne bachche hain?
prompt.en: On a school trip there are 6 autos, with 4 children sitting in each auto. How many children are there in all?

why.hi: 6 auto, har auto mein 4 bachche: 6 × 4 = 24
why.en: 6 autos with 4 children each: 6 × 4 = 24

simpler.hi: 6 auto hain aur har auto mein 4 bachche, toh 6 baar 4 jodo. Ya 4 ke pahade mein 6 tak jao.
simpler.en: There are 6 autos with 4 children in each, so add 4 six times. Or go up the 4 table to 6.

prompt.hi: Ek tokri mein 7 aam hain. 4 tokri mein kul kitne aam hain?
prompt.en: A basket has 7 mangoes. How many mangoes are there in 4 baskets?

why.hi: har tokri mein 7 aam, toh 4 tokri mein kul 4 × 7 = 28 aam
why.en: each basket has 7 mangoes, so 4 baskets have 4 × 7 = 28 mangoes in all

simpler.hi: Har tokri mein 7 aam hain, toh 4 tokri matlab 4 baar 7. 7 ke pahade mein 4 tak jao.
simpler.en: Each basket has 7 mangoes, so 4 baskets means 4 times 7. Go up the 7 table to 4.

prompt.hi: Function mein kursiyon ki 3 row hain, aur har row mein 9 kursi. Kul kitni kursi hain?
prompt.en: At a function there are 3 rows of chairs, with 9 chairs in each row. How many chairs are there in all?

why.hi: 3 row hain aur har row mein 9 kursi, toh kul kursi 3 × 9 = 27
why.en: there are 3 rows with 9 chairs in each row, so the chairs in all are 3 × 9 = 27

simpler.hi: 3 row hain aur har row mein 9 kursi, toh yeh 3 × 9 hai. 9 ke pahade mein 3 tak jao.
simpler.en: There are 3 rows with 9 chairs in each, so this is 3 × 9. Go up the 9 table to 3.

ladder.why: egg trays of 6 → 3 equal groups; warm-up
teams of 6 players → 7 × 6 in a story
9 rows of 8 chairs, 5 taken away → multiply first, then subtract: 67
far transfer: 3 children + 1 teacher per auto → group size first, then 8 × 4

remediation.move: equal groups on the then-card's board: × joins the same group once for every group; + is a single join → × is repeated equal groups, + is one join

say.hi: Guna matlab ek jaisa group baar-baar jodna, jitne group utni baar. Jodna matlab bas ek baar milana. Board par har dabba ek group hai.
say.en: Multiplying means adding the same group again and again, once for every group. Adding means joining just once. On the board, each box is one group.

simpler.hi: Guna mein har group ek-ek baar judta hai, jitne group utni baar. Jod mein sirf ek baar.
simpler.en: In multiplying, each group is added once, as many times as there are groups. In adding, just once.

prompt.hi: Ek dabbe mein 8 pencil hain. 4 dabbon mein kul kitni pencil hain?
prompt.en: A box has 8 pencils. How many pencils are there in 4 boxes?

why.hi: 4 dabbe, har dabbe mein 8 pencil: 4 × 8 = 32
why.en: 4 boxes of 8 pencils each: 4 × 8 = 32

simpler.hi: Har dabbe mein 8 pencil hain, aur 4 dabbe hain. Toh 8 ko 4 baar jodo.
simpler.en: Each box has 8 pencils, and there are 4 boxes. So add 8 four times.

bridgeToNext.hi: Ab tak humne pahade ke facts nikale. Ab kuch khaas facts dekhenge: 0 se guna, 1 se guna, kram badalna aur double karna.
bridgeToNext.en: So far we worked out times-table facts. Next we look at some special facts: times 0, times 1, changing the order, and doubling.

simpler.hi: Pahade ke facts nikalna aa gaya. Agle hisse mein kuch khaas facts dekhenge, jaise 0 se guna, 1 se guna aur double karna.
simpler.en: You can work out table facts now. Next we see some special facts, like times 0, times 1 and doubling.

hook.convey: special facts that save work: groups with nothing in them (× 0), just one group (× 1), an array turned around (order), twice the groups (double a known fact)

use.hi: Ek bowler ne 3 over daale aur kisi bhi over mein ek bhi run nahi diya. Aaj dekhenge ki aise mein guna se kul run kaise nikalte hain.
use.en: A bowler bowled 3 overs and gave away no runs in any over. Today we see how multiplying gives the total runs in a case like this.

use.hi: Kitchen mein laddoo plate mein lagaane hain: kabhi plate khaali rehti hai, kabhi sirf 1 plate hoti hai. Aaj dekhenge ki 0 aur 1 se guna karne par kya hota hai.
use.en: In the kitchen laddoos go on plates: sometimes a plate stays empty, sometimes there is only 1 plate. Today we see what happens when we multiply by 0 and by 1.

explain.convey: 8 + 0 keeps 8 (nothing added); 8 × 0 = 8 empty plates → no laddoos → 0; anything × 0 is 0

point.hi: 8 + 0 mein 8 mein kuch nahi joda, toh 8 hi raha. 8 × 0 ka matlab 8 plate, aur har plate mein 0 laddoo. 8 khaali plate mein kul 0 laddoo hain.
point.en: In 8 + 0 nothing is added to 8, so it stays 8. 8 × 0 means 8 plates with 0 laddoos on each plate. 8 empty plates hold 0 laddoos in all.

prompt.hi: 5 plate hain aur har plate khaali hai. Kya 5 × 0 = 5 hoga, haan ya nahi?
prompt.en: There are 5 plates and every plate is empty. Is 5 × 0 = 5, yes or no?

why.hi: 8 khaali plate mein 0 laddoo the, toh 5 khaali plate mein bhi 0: 5 × 0 = 0
why.en: 8 empty plates held 0 laddoos, so 5 empty plates hold 0 too: 5 × 0 = 0

simpler.hi: Har plate khaali hai, yaani har plate pe 0 laddoo. 5 khaali plate pe bhi ek bhi laddoo nahi hota.
simpler.en: Every plate is empty, so each plate has 0 laddoos. 5 empty plates still hold not a single laddoo.

explain.convey: 1 × 7 = 1 box of 7 pencils = 7; 7 × 1 = 7 children with 1 pencil each = 7; × 1 keeps the number the same, multiplying does not always make it bigger

point.hi: 1 × 7 matlab 1 dibba, aur dibbe mein 7 pencil, toh kul 7. 7 × 1 matlab 7 bachche, har ek ke paas 1 pencil, toh bhi kul 7. 1 se guna karne par number utna hi rehta hai, bada nahi hota.
point.en: 1 × 7 means 1 box with 7 pencils in it, so 7 in all. 7 × 1 means 7 children with 1 pencil each, so again 7 in all. Multiplying by 1 keeps the number the same; it does not get bigger.

prompt.hi: 1 dibbe mein 9 crayon hain. 1 × 9 ka jawab 9 se zyada hai, kam hai, ya utna hi?
prompt.en: 1 box has 9 crayons. Is the answer to 1 × 9 more than 9, less than 9, or the same?

why.hi: 1 × 7 mein 1 dibba aur kul 7 tha; isi tarah 1 dibba, 9 crayon, toh 1 × 9 = 9
why.en: 1 × 7 was 1 box, 7 in all; so 1 box of 9 crayons gives 1 × 9 = 9

simpler.hi: 1 × 9 matlab sirf 1 dibba, jismein 9 crayon hain. Socho, ek hi dibbe mein kul kitne crayon hue.
simpler.en: 1 × 9 means just 1 box with 9 crayons in it. Think how many crayons one box holds in all.

explain.convey: an array of laddoos turned around swaps its rows and columns, but the laddoos stay the same → changing the order of a multiplication does not change the answer. Told as the rule over the ask's board, with no other example numbers

point.hi: Laddoo ko row aur column mein lagao, yeh array hai. Array ko ghumao toh row aur column badal jaate hain, par laddoo utne hi rehte hain: na koi juda, na koi hata. Toh guna mein kram badlo, jawab wahi rehta hai.
point.en: Set laddoos out in rows and columns: that is an array. Turn the array and the rows and columns swap, but the laddoos stay just as many: none added, none taken away. So change the order in a multiplication and the answer stays the same.

prompt.hi: 7 × 6 = 42 hai. Kya 6 × 7 ka jawab isse alag hoga, haan ya nahi?
prompt.en: 7 × 6 = 42. Will the answer to 6 × 7 be different from this, yes or no?

why.hi: 7 × 6 = 42 hai, aur kram badlo toh kul nahi badalta, 6 × 7 bhi 42 hai
why.en: 7 × 6 = 42, and changing the order keeps the total, so 6 × 7 is 42 too

simpler.hi: Array ko ghumao toh sirf row aur column badalte hain, laddoo wahi rehte hain. 7 × 6 aur 6 × 7 bhi aise hi hain.
simpler.en: Turn an array and only the rows and columns swap; the laddoos stay the same. 7 × 6 and 6 × 7 are just like that.

explain.convey: a known fact helps when the groups double: twice as many groups of the same size hold twice as many things → the new answer is double the known one. Told as the method over the ask's board, with no other example numbers

point.hi: Jo fact pata hai, usse naya fact nikal sakte ho. Agar group dugne ho jaayein aur har group utna hi bada rahe, toh cheezein bhi dugni ho jaati hain. Toh naya jawab, pata hue jawab ka double hota hai.
point.en: You can get a new fact from one you know. If the groups become twice as many and each group stays the same size, the things become twice as many too. So the new answer is double the known answer.

prompt.hi: 4 × 8 = 32 hai. Toh 8 × 8 kitna hoga?
prompt.en: 4 × 8 = 32. So what is 8 × 8?

why.hi: 8 group, 4 group ke dugne hain, toh 8 × 8 = 32 + 32 = 64
why.en: 8 groups are twice 4 groups, so 8 × 8 = 32 + 32 = 64

simpler.hi: 8 group, 4 group ka double hain. Toh 8 × 8, 4 × 8 ka double hai, yaani 32 aur 32 jodo.
simpler.en: 8 groups are double 4 groups. So 8 × 8 is double 4 × 8, that is, add 32 and 32.

problem.hi: 6 × 6 kitna hota hai? Jo fact pata hai, 3 × 6 = 18, uski madad se nikalo.
problem.en: What is 6 × 6? Work it out using a fact you know, 3 × 6 = 18.

simpler.hi: Humein 3 × 6 = 18 pata hai. Iski madad se 6 × 6 nikalna hai.
simpler.en: We know 3 × 6 = 18. We use it to find 6 × 6.

why.hi: 3 aur 3 milkar 6 bante hain
why.en: 3 and 3 together make 6

simpler.hi: 3 aur 3 milkar 6 bante hain. Toh 6, 3 ka double hai.
simpler.en: 3 and 3 together make 6. So 6 is double 3.

do.en: Now think of doubling the groups

why.hi: dugne group mein dugni cheezein hoti hain
why.en: twice as many groups hold twice as many things

simpler.hi: Group double hue, toh cheezein bhi double hongi. Isliye 6 × 6, 3 × 6 ka double hai.
simpler.en: When the groups double, the things double too. So 6 × 6 is double 3 × 6.

prompt.hi: Ab 18 ka double karo. 18 + 18 kitna hai, yaani 6 × 6 kitna hai?
prompt.en: Now double 18. What is 18 + 18, that is, what is 6 × 6?

simpler.hi: 18 ko 18 mein jodo. Pehle dahai jodo, phir ikai.
simpler.en: Add 18 to 18. Add the tens first, then the ones.

why.hi: pata hua fact 3 × 6 = 18 hai, aur 6 × 6 uska double, toh 18 + 18 = 36
why.en: the known fact is 3 × 6 = 18, and 6 × 6 is its double, so 18 + 18 = 36

why.hi: pata hua fact 3 × 6 = 18 hai, aur 6 × 6 uska double, toh 18 + 18 = 36
why.en: the known fact is 3 × 6 = 18, and 6 × 6 is its double, so 18 + 18 = 36

prompt.hi: Ek bowler ne 4 over daale, aur kisi bhi over mein ek bhi run nahi diya. Usne kul kitne run diye?
prompt.en: A bowler bowled 4 overs and gave away no runs in any over. How many runs were given away in all?

why.hi: bowler ne kisi bhi over mein ek bhi run nahi diya, toh 4 × 0 = 0
why.en: the bowler gave not a single run in any over, so 4 × 0 = 0

simpler.hi: Har over mein ek bhi run nahi gaya. Khaali over jodne se kuch nahi badhta, chahe 4 over hon.
simpler.en: Not a single run was given in any over. Adding empty overs adds nothing, even if there are 4 overs.

prompt.hi: 2 × 8 matlab 8 ke 2 group, aur 8 × 2 matlab 2 ke 8 group. {friend} ka kehna hai ki dono ke jawab barabar hain. Kya yeh sahi hai?
prompt.en: 2 × 8 means 2 groups of 8, and 8 × 2 means 8 groups of 2. {friend} says the two answers are the same. Is that right?

why.hi: 2 × 8 aur 8 × 2 dono 16 hain, kram badalne se kul nahi badalta
why.en: 2 × 8 and 8 × 2 are both 16; changing the order does not change the total

simpler.hi: 8 ke 2 group wala array ghumao, toh 2 ke 8 group ban jaate hain. Cheezein wahi rehti hain, sirf row aur column badalte hain.
simpler.en: Turn the array of 2 groups of 8 and it becomes 8 groups of 2. The things stay the same; only the rows and columns swap.

prompt.hi: 8 bachchon mein se har ek ke paas 1 pencil hai, yaani 8 × 1. Farhan kehta hai ki kul 9 pencil hain, kyunki guna se number bada hota hai. Kya Farhan sahi hai?
prompt.en: 8 children have 1 pencil each, that is 8 × 1. Farhan says there are 9 pencils in all, because multiplying makes a number bigger. Is Farhan right?

why.hi: Farhan ke 9 pencil galat hain; 8 bachchon mein har ek ke paas 1 pencil, toh 8 × 1 = 8
why.en: Farhan's 9 pencils is wrong; 8 children with 1 pencil each make 8 × 1 = 8

simpler.hi: Har bachche ke paas 1 pencil hai, aur 8 bachche hain. 1 se guna karne par number wahi rehta hai, bada nahi hota.
simpler.en: Each child has 1 pencil, and there are 8 children. Multiplying by 1 keeps the number the same; it does not grow.

ladder.why: 6 × 0 as a bare fact → 0 (the remediation then-card now uses 9 boxes)
8 tickets on each of 4 sheets → equal groups call for 8 × 4, not 8 + 4
two-step story: twice as many rounds at 6 points a win → 48

remediation.move: plates story: 8 plates, nothing on any plate → how many laddoos on the plates; then 8 + 0 beside 8 × 0: adding nothing keeps 8, 8 groups of nothing hold nothing

say.hi: 8 plate hain par har plate khaali hai, toh 8 plate par ek bhi laddoo nahi. 8 + 0 alag hai: wahan 8 mein kuch nahi joda, toh 8 hi raha.
say.en: There are 8 plates but every plate is empty, so the 8 plates hold not a single laddoo. 8 + 0 is different: there nothing is added to 8, so it stays 8.

simpler.hi: 8 khaali plate mein ek bhi laddoo nahi. Par 8 + 0 mein 8 mein kuch nahi juda, toh 8 hi raha.
simpler.en: 8 empty plates hold no laddoo at all. But in 8 + 0 nothing is added to 8, so it stays 8.

prompt.hi: Kiska jawab 0 hai: 9 + 0 ka ya 9 × 0 ka?
prompt.en: Which one gives 0: 9 + 0 or 9 × 0?

why.hi: 9 + 0 mein 9 mein kuch nahi juda, toh 9 hi raha; 9 × 0 matlab 9 khaali group, toh 0
why.en: 9 + 0 adds nothing to 9, so it stays 9; 9 × 0 is 9 empty groups, so 0

simpler.hi: Jodne mein 0 se kuch nahi badhta. Guna mein agar har group khaali ho, toh kul mein kuch nahi bachta.
simpler.en: Adding 0 changes nothing. In multiplying, if every group is empty, the total is nothing.

remediation.move: array of laddoos 4 rows of 6, turned a quarter turn → 6 rows of 4; no laddoo added or taken away → both totals the same

say.hi: 4 × 6 ka array ghumao toh 6 × 4 ban jaata hai. Na koi laddoo juda, na koi hata, toh dono mein utne hi laddoo hain.
say.en: Turn the 4 × 6 array and it becomes 6 × 4. No laddoo was added and none was taken away, so both hold the same number of laddoos.

simpler.hi: 4 × 6 ko ghumao toh 6 × 4 banta hai. Laddoo utne hi rahe, toh dono barabar hain.
simpler.en: Turn 4 × 6 around and it is 6 × 4. The laddoos stay the same, so both are equal.

prompt.hi: Laddoo ka array: 2 row, har row mein 7. Ghumaya toh 7 row, har row mein 2. Kya kul laddoo badle, haan ya nahi?
prompt.en: Laddoos in 2 rows of 7, then turned to 7 rows of 2. Did the total change, yes or no?

why.hi: har row mein 7 ki 2 row, ya har row mein 2 ki 7 row, dono mein 14 laddoo hain
why.en: 2 rows of 7 or 7 rows of 2, both hold 14 laddoos

simpler.hi: Array ko ghumane se sirf row aur column badle. Koi laddoo na hataaya gaya, na joda gaya.
simpler.en: Turning the array only swapped the rows and columns. No laddoo was taken away or added.

remediation.move: one box with 7 pencils in it: how many groups (1), how many in each (7), how many in all (7) → one group of 7 cannot be more than 7

say.hi: 1 × 7 matlab 7 ka sirf 1 group. Ek dibbe mein 7 pencil hain, toh kul 7 hi hain, zyada nahi.
say.en: 1 × 7 means just 1 group of 7. One box has 7 pencils, so there are just 7 in all, not more.

simpler.hi: Ek hi dibba hai, usmein 7 pencil. Toh kul 7 hi hain.
simpler.en: There is only one box, with 7 pencils in it. So there are 7 in all.

prompt.hi: 6 ko kis number se guna karein ki jawab 6 hi rahe: 1 se ya 2 se?
prompt.en: What should 6 be multiplied by so the answer stays 6: by 1 or by 2?

why.hi: 6 ko 1 se guna karo toh 6 ka 1 group, jawab 6 hi; 2 se guna karo toh 12
why.en: multiply 6 by 1 and it is one group of 6, the answer stays 6; by 2 it becomes 12

simpler.hi: 6 ka sirf ek group utna hi hota hai jitna 6. Do group lo toh cheezein dugni ho jaati hain.
simpler.en: Just one group of 6 is the same as 6. Take two groups and the things double.

bridgeToNext.hi: Ab saare pahade ek saath guna chart mein dekhenge. Wahan har row mein ek pattern chhupa hai.
bridgeToNext.en: Next we see all the tables together in the multiplication chart. Every row there hides a pattern.

simpler.hi: Ab guna chart dekhenge. Usme saare pahade ek saath hain.
simpler.en: Now we look at the multiplication chart. It has all the tables together.

hook.convey: the multiplication chart is full of patterns: along a row each next fact grows by the row's number; the 5s end in 5 or 0; the 4s are double the 2s; in the 9s the tens go up and the ones go down

use.hi: Pahada ek song jaisa hai: 4, 8, 12, 16, har baar wahi taal. Aaj guna chart mein aisi hi taal dhoondhenge.
use.en: A times table is like a song: 4, 8, 12, 16, the same beat every time. Today we find beats like this in the multiplication chart.

use.hi: Guna chart ek game jaisa hai: pattern pakdo toh agla number bina guna kiye bata sakte ho.
use.en: The multiplication chart is like a game: catch the pattern and you can tell the next number without multiplying.

explain.convey: along a row of the chart each next fact grows by the row's own number, not by 1: in the 5 row the next fact is 5 more. Told as the rule over the ask's board (5 × 2 = 10 → 5 × 3), with no other example numbers

point.hi: Pahade mein agla fact pichhle se 1 nahi badhta. Woh utna badhta hai jitne ka pahada hai. 5 ke pahade mein agla fact chahiye, toh pichhle jawab mein 1 nahi, 5 aur jodo.
point.en: In a table the next fact does not grow by 1 from the one before. It grows by the table's own number. For the next fact in the 5 table, add 5 more to the last answer, not 1.

prompt.hi: 5 × 2 = 10 hai. Isse socho, 5 × 3 kitna hoga?
prompt.en: 5 × 2 = 10. Using this, what is 5 × 3?

why.hi: 5 ke pahade mein agla fact 5 badhta hai: 10 + 5 = 15
why.en: in the 5 table the next fact grows by 5: 10 + 5 = 15

simpler.hi: 5 ke pahade mein har agla number 5 badhta hai, 1 nahi. Toh 10 mein 5 jodo.
simpler.en: In the 5 table each next number grows by 5, not 1. So add 5 to 10.

explain.convey: the 5 table 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30 → last digit goes 5, 0, 5, 0; 5 × an odd number ends in 5, 5 × an even number ends in 0

point.hi: 5 ka pahada dekho: 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30. Aakhri ank baari-baari se 5, 0, 5, 0 aata hai. 5 ko odd number se guna karo toh aakhri ank 5, even number se karo toh 0.
point.en: Look at the 5 table: 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30. The last digit goes 5, 0, 5, 0 in turn. Multiply 5 by an odd number and the last digit is 5; by an even number and it is 0.

prompt.hi: Bina guna kiye batao: kya 5 × 7 ka jawab 0 par khatam hoga, haan ya nahi?
prompt.en: Without multiplying, tell me: will the answer to 5 × 7 end in 0, yes or no?

why.hi: 7 odd hai, aur 5 ka pahada odd number par aakhri ank 5 deta hai
why.en: 7 is odd, and the 5 table gives a last digit of 5 for an odd number

simpler.hi: 5 ko odd number se guna karo toh aakhri ank 5 aata hai, even se karo toh 0. Ab dekho 7 odd hai ya even.
simpler.en: 5 times an odd number ends in 5, and 5 times an even number ends in 0. Now see whether 7 is odd or even.

explain.convey: 4 is double 2, so every number in the 4 table is double the 2 table's number in the same place. Told as the rule over the ask's board, with no other example numbers

point.hi: 4, 2 ka double hai. Isliye 4 ka pahada, 2 ke pahade ka double hai: 4 ke pahade ka har number, 2 ke pahade mein usi jagah wale number ka double hota hai.
point.en: 4 is double 2. So the 4 table is double the 2 table: every number in the 4 table is double the 2 table's number in the same place.

prompt.hi: 2 × 9 = 18 hai. 4 × 9 nikalne ke liye 18 ka kya karoge: 2 jodoge ya double karoge?
prompt.en: 2 × 9 = 18. To get 4 × 9, what will you do to 18: add 2, or double it?

why.hi: 4, 2 ka double hai, toh 4 × 9 bhi 2 × 9 ka double hai: 18 + 18
why.en: 4 is double 2, so 4 × 9 is double 2 × 9 too: 18 + 18

simpler.hi: Board par 2 × 9 aur 4 × 9 dekho. Socho 4 group, 2 group se kaise bante hain, aur 18 ke saath bhi wahi karo.
simpler.en: Look at 2 × 9 and 4 × 9 on the board. Think how 4 groups come from 2 groups, and do the same to 18.

problem.hi: 9 ka pahada: 9, 18, 27, 36, 45, 54, 63, 72. Yeh 9 × 1 se 9 × 8 tak hain. Ankon ka pattern dhoondho aur bina guna kiye 9 × 9 likho.
problem.en: The 9 table: 9, 18, 27, 36, 45, 54, 63, 72. These are 9 × 1 to 9 × 8. Find the pattern in the digits and write 9 × 9 without multiplying.

simpler.hi: 9 ke pahade mein har baar dahai ka ank 1 badhta hai aur ikai ka ank 1 ghatta hai. 72 ke baad bhi yahi karo.
simpler.en: In the 9 table, each time the tens digit goes up by 1 and the ones digit goes down by 1. Do the same after 72.

do.en: First look at the tens digits: 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7

steps.result: dahai ka ank har baar 1 badhta hai

why.hi: 9 jodna matlab 10 jodna aur 1 ghatana, toh dahai 1 badhti hai
why.en: adding 9 is adding 10 and taking 1 away, so the tens go up by 1

simpler.hi: Dahai ke ank dekho: 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7. Har baar dahai ka ank 1 badhta hai.
simpler.en: Look at the tens digits: 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7. Each time the tens digit goes up by 1.

do.en: Now look at the ones digits: 9, 8, 7, 6, 5, 4, 3, 2

steps.result: ikai ka ank har baar 1 ghatta hai

why.hi: har baar wahi 1 ghataya jaata hai
why.en: that same 1 is taken away each time

simpler.hi: Ikai ke ank dekho: 9, 8, 7, 6, 5, 4, 3, 2. Har baar ikai ka ank 1 ghatta hai.
simpler.en: Look at the ones digits: 9, 8, 7, 6, 5, 4, 3, 2. Each time the ones digit goes down by 1.

prompt.hi: Ab 72 ke baad dahai 1 badhao aur ikai 1 ghatao. 9 × 9 kitna hai?
prompt.en: Now after 72, raise the tens by 1 and lower the ones by 1. What is 9 × 9?

simpler.hi: 72 ke dahai wale ank mein 1 jodo. Aur ikai wale ank mein se 1 ghatao.
simpler.en: Add 1 to the tens digit of 72. And take 1 from the ones digit.

why.hi: 9 ka pahada 63, 72 mein dahai ank 1 badhta, ikai ank 1 ghatta hai, toh 72 ke baad 81
why.en: the 9 table's 63, 72: tens go up 1 and ones down 1, so after 72 comes 81

why.hi: 9 ka pahada 63, 72 mein dahai ank 1 badhta, ikai ank 1 ghatta hai, toh 72 ke baad 81
why.en: the 9 table's 63, 72: tens go up 1 and ones down 1, so after 72 comes 81

prompt.hi: {friend} ne 6 ka pahada likha: 6, 12, 18, 19. Aakhri number 19 sahi hai ya galat?
prompt.en: {friend} wrote the 6 table: 6, 12, 18, 19. Is the last number, 19, right or wrong?

why.hi: 6 ka pahada 6, 12, 18 mein har baar 6 badhta; aakhri number 19 toh 18 se sirf 1 zyada, isliye galat
why.en: 6, 12, 18 grow by 6 each time; the last number, 19, is only 1 more than 18, so it is wrong

simpler.hi: 6 ke pahade mein har agla number 6 badhta hai. Har do numbers ke beech ka farak dekho.
simpler.en: In the 6 table each next number grows by 6. Look at the gap between each pair of numbers.

prompt.hi: Guna chart ki 7 wali row: 7, 14, 21, 28. 28 ke baad agla number kya hai?
prompt.en: The 7 row of the multiplication chart: 7, 14, 21, 28. What is the next number after 28?

why.hi: 7 wali row 7, 14, 21, 28 har baar 7 badhti hai, toh agla number 28 + 7 = 35
why.en: the 7 row 7, 14, 21, 28 grows by 7 each time, so the next number is 28 + 7 = 35

simpler.hi: Yeh row har baar 7 badhti hai. Toh 28 mein 7 jodo.
simpler.en: This row grows by 7 each time. So add 7 to 28.

prompt.hi: Har over mein 6 ball daali jaati hain. 9 over mein 54 ball huin. 10 over mein kitni ball hongi?
prompt.en: Each over has 6 balls bowled. 9 overs had 54 balls. How many balls are there in 10 overs?

why.hi: 9 over mein 54 ball, aur ek over aur matlab 6 ball aur: 54 + 6 = 60
why.en: 9 overs had 54 balls, and one over more means 6 balls more: 54 + 6 = 60

simpler.hi: Ek over aur matlab 6 ball aur. Toh 54 mein 6 jodo.
simpler.en: One more over means 6 more balls. So add 6 to 54.

ladder.why: predict whether 5 × 9 ends in 0 or 5 → the 5s pattern

remediation.move: equal groups: one more in each of 3 groups → 3 new → the next fact in the 3 table is +3, not +1

say.hi: Agla fact pichhle se utna badhta hai jitne group hain, 1 nahi. 3 group hon, toh har group mein ek aur aane se 3 naye judte hain.
say.en: The next fact grows by as many as there are groups, not by 1. With 3 groups, one more in each group adds 3 new ones.

simpler.hi: Har group mein ek aur aaya, toh 3 group mein 3 naye aaye. Isliye agla fact 3 badhta hai, 1 nahi.
simpler.en: Each group got one more, so 3 groups got 3 new. So the next fact grows by 3, not 1.

prompt.hi: 4 thaliyan hain, har thali mein 5 laddoo, kul 20. Har thali mein 1 laddoo aur rakha. Ab kul kitne laddoo hain?
prompt.en: 4 plates have 5 laddoos each, 20 in all. 1 more laddoo is put on each plate. How many laddoos are there now?

why.hi: pehle kul 20 the; har thali mein 1 aur aaya, toh 4 naye, ab 20 + 4 = 24
why.en: there were 20 before; each plate got 1 more, so 4 new, now 20 + 4 = 24

simpler.hi: Ek laddoo har thali par gaya, aur thaliyan 4 hain. Pehle naye laddoo gino, phir 20 mein jodo.
simpler.en: One laddoo went on every plate, and there are 4 plates. Count the new laddoos first, then add them to 20.
